exercises.title: St Paul's Cathedral
exercises.text: St Paul's is Christopher Wren's cathedral. It's from after the Great Fire of London of 1666. Today visitors climb more than five hundred steps to the top of the dome. In the Whispering Gallery you whisper next to the wall, and your friend on the other side hears you!

dialog.title: En la Whispering Gallery
dialog.setting: Dentro de la catedral de St Paul's, con una guía

lines.t: Welcome to St Paul's! Do you have tickets?
Yes, we do. Do you have an audio guide in Spanish?
Yes, we do. Here you are.
Thank you. Do people climb to the top of the dome?
lines.es: Gracias. ¿La gente sube hasta lo alto de la cúpula?

lines.t: Yes! There are more than five hundred steps.
Five hundred? I don't climb five hundred steps!
Then visit the Whispering Gallery. Whisper to the wall!
lines.es: Entonces visite la Galería de los Susurros. ¡Susúrrele a la pared!

lines.t: Wonderful! My husband can hear me on the other side!
lines.es: ¡Maravilloso! ¡Mi marido me oye desde el otro lado!

options: Susurra en la Galería de los Susurros
questions.answer: Susurra en la Galería de los Susurros
